nodes.label: Clean Architecture
nodes.rationale: Strict layer separation chosen to ensure maintainability and scalability; outer layers depend on inner layers, Domain depends on nothing.

nodes.label: Vertical Slicing & Screaming Architecture
nodes.rationale: Feature-based folder organisation so that the business domain is immediately visible from the directory structure.

nodes.label: MVVM Pattern
nodes.rationale: Separates UI from state management so that Views are reactive and dumb; business logic lives in ViewModels and Use Cases.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern
nodes.rationale: Abstracts data sources behind interfaces defined in Domain so that Infrastructure details are swappable without touching business logic.
